FINANCE COMMITTEE
                                     MINUTES

A meeting of the Finance Committee was held on Tuesday, June 16, 2026, in City Council
Chambers and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Ken Esquibel. Chairman; Mark Moody: Jeff White (via Zoom):
and Lawrence Wolfe.


                                     AGENDA ITEMS

13.    ORDINANCE 3td READING Defining the Terms and Conditions of Employment for
                                       —




       sworn officers of the Cheyenne Police Department for July 2026 until the end of the Fiscal
       Year 2027.

Mr. Moody moved to approve on 3t and final reading. seconded by Mr. Wolfe. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Captain David Janes, Police Department, provided a staff report.

30.    RESOLUTION Authorizing submission of an application to the Wyoming State Loan
                        —




       and Investment Board for a loan from the Wyoming Drinking Water State Revolving Fund
       for an amount not to exceed $20,000,000.00 for the Lead Service Line Investigation and
       Replacement Project and authorizing the Mayor, City Clerk, and Director of the Board of
       Public Utilities to execute the application and all related documents. (SPONSOR MR.—




       ESQUIBEL)

Mr. Moody moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Wolfe. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Bryce Don, Board of Public Utilities Capital Projects Supervisor, provided a staff report with
assistance from Jeff Foreman, Board of Public Utilities GIS Supervisor. Chairman Esquihel and
all committee members commented on the item.

31.    RESOLUTION Authorizing the submission of a Transportation Alternatives Program
                        —




       Grant Application for the Pershing Boulevard and Windmill Road Intersection Project.
       (SPONSOR MR. SEGRAVE)
                    —




Mr. Moody moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Wolfe. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Elizabeth Finochiaro. Grants Manager. provided a staff report.     Committee members Moody.
White and Wolfe commented on the item.

32.    RESOLUTION Authorizing the acceptance of a donation from Taligrass ILS Holdings,
                        —




       LLC for affordable housing purposes and authorizing the Mayor to execute a Donation
       Agreement. (SPONSOR MR. SEGRAVE)
                                —
